title: Acquisition of property.
bodyText:
For the purposes of this part, the director of transportation may acquire for controlled-access facilities and service roads:

(1) Property, as defined in chapter 101, by gift, devise, or purchase; or

(2) Property by eminent domain under chapter 101.
bodyHtml:
§264-63  Acquisition of property.  For the purposes of this part, the director of transportation may acquire for controlled-access facilities and service roads:

     (1)  Property, as defined in chapter 101, by gift, devise, or purchase; or

     (2)  Property by eminent domain under chapter 101. [L 1960, c 3, pt of §2; Supp, §111-46; HRS §264-63]
